name: Glamour

components.pose: He stands tall in a wide, grounded power stance, shoulders squared and chest open, chin slightly raised, a steady commanding gaze to the camera and the faint trace of a confident smile, a light breeze stirring his hair.
components.effects: A few fine ice crystals glitter in the air around him, faint {{MAGIC}} frost-light on his armor - understated, nothing busy.

notes: Daily-post glamour shot: signature armor, powerful stance, element-matched background, light magic only.
